title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
description: Discover ten distinct study environments across Chapman University's Orange and Rinker campuses, from high-tech labs to quiet outdoor terraces.

cards.title: Late Night Rotunda Sessions
cards.subtitle: Leatherby Libraries, 1st Floor
cards.notes: Access the 1st floor Rotunda for late-night study. It remains open until 3 AM on weeknights during the semester and 24/7 during finals week with a valid Chapman ID.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated late-night study space on the first floor of the main library.
cards.evidence_claim: The Study Commons located inside the First Floor Rotunda is open Monday - Friday: 12 AM - 3 AM and 24/7 during finals week.
cards.access_notes: Open until 3 AM Mon-Fri; 24/7 during finals. Valid Chapman ID required for entry after hours.

cards.title: Open-Air Academic Views
cards.subtitle: Argyros Forum, Top Floor
cards.notes: Head to the top floor for an outdoor study environment featuring tables and benches. It offers a quiet alternative to the library with fresh air and campus views.
cards.short_summary: A quiet outdoor patio located on the roof of the student union building.
cards.evidence_claim: The roof patio of Argyros Forum features plenty of tables and benches and offers a peaceful environment conducive for studying.
cards.source_title: Hidden Places to Study on Campus - Chapman Blogs
cards.access_notes: Accessible during Argyros Forum building hours.

cards.title: Write on the Walls
cards.subtitle: Keck Center for Science and Engineering
cards.notes: Utilize the writable hallway walls for group brainstorming or complex problem-solving. These spaces are designed for spontaneous collaboration between STEM classes.
cards.short_summary: Hallway spaces in the Keck Center featuring walls designed for writing and collaboration.
cards.evidence_claim: Everything in the Keck Center, including the hallways where you can write on the walls, is designed to foster collaboration.
cards.access_notes: Open during Keck Center building hours.

cards.title: High-Altitude Focus
cards.subtitle: Beckman Hall, 4th Floor
cards.notes: Find a quiet spot on the fourth floor near the faculty offices. The outdoor patio and large windows provide ample sunlight and a low-traffic environment for reading.
cards.short_summary: A quiet fourth-floor patio and hallway study area in Beckman Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: The fourth floor of Beckman Hall is quiet and features the Beckman Patio and large windows with lots of sunlight.
cards.source_title: The Best Study Spots at Chapman | The Odyssey Online
cards.access_notes: Best for quiet individual study; accessible during building hours.

cards.title: Rinker Campus Research Hub
cards.subtitle: 9401 Jeronimo Road, Irvine
cards.notes: Reserve one of 12 collaborative study rooms or use the 20 individual spaces. This facility is dedicated to Rinker students and focuses on health sciences resources.
cards.short_summary: A specialized study facility for health science students at the Rinker Campus in Irvine.
cards.evidence_claim: The Health Sciences Study Commons provides twelve collaborative study rooms and twenty individual study spaces for Rinker students.
cards.access_notes: Restricted to Rinker students, staff, and faculty. Rooms reservable up to 7 days in advance.

cards.title: Fourth Floor Fresh Air
cards.subtitle: Leatherby Libraries, 4th Floor
cards.notes: Study outdoors on the library's top floor. This terrace features comfortable seating and tables, perfect for those who prefer a breeze while they work.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor study terrace located on the fourth floor of the Leatherby Libraries.
cards.evidence_claim: Located on the 4th floor of the Leatherby Libraries, the Fashionables Terrace features outdoor tables and comfortable seating for study.

cards.title: Tech-Heavy Study Zone
cards.subtitle: Argyros Forum, Room 302
cards.notes: Access PCs, Macs, and color printing in this student union tech hub. It includes a reservable private room for group projects and a lounge area with couches.
cards.short_summary: A computer lab and study lounge in Argyros Forum with specialized printing services.
cards.evidence_claim: The Panther Digital Den (AF 302) has PCs, Macs, color printing, and a private room that can be reserved.
cards.source_title: The Best Study Spots at Chapman | The Odyssey Online
cards.access_notes: Open during Argyros Forum hours; room reservation recommended for groups.

cards.title: Performing Arts Retreat
cards.subtitle: Sandi Simon Center for Dance
cards.notes: Take advantage of the dedicated study spaces and student lounge within the brand-new dance center. It provides a modern environment for performing arts students.
cards.short_summary: A new facility for dance students that includes dedicated study and lounge areas.
cards.evidence_claim: The new Sandi Simon Center for Dance facility features classrooms, study spaces and a student lounge.
cards.access_notes: Primarily serves College of Performing Arts students.

cards.title: Quiet Courtyard Tables
cards.subtitle: Doti Hall, East Side
cards.notes: Find a table under an umbrella on the east side of Doti Hall. This spot is known for being quiet and having plenty of space to spread out study materials.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor courtyard area with shaded tables located next to Doti Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: The special spot on the east-side of Doti Hall is a really quiet location with plenty of tables, benches, and umbrellas.
cards.source_title: Hidden Places to Study on Campus - Chapman Blogs
cards.access_notes: Publicly accessible outdoor area; can get busy during lunch hours.

cards.title: High-Tech Group Collaboration
cards.subtitle: Leatherby Libraries
cards.notes: Reserve these rooms for groups of 8-12. They feature glass boards, Apple TV, and conferencing tools like Zoom, making them ideal for major group presentations.
cards.short_summary: Large, technology-equipped rooms in the library designed for group media work.
cards.evidence_claim: Advanced Media Rooms seat 8 to 12 people and contain a glass board, computer, TV, and Apple TV, compatible with Zoom and Teams.
cards.access_notes: Reservable up to 7 days in advance by students.
